title: OP SCRIPT ALL WORKING FEATURES I cidHub
features:
Anime Fight — cidHub Universal Automation v1.0

Full-featured automation hub for Anime Fight, supporting all core systems like farming, tower, trial, events, and reroll.

Features
Farm System:
AutoFarm, AutoAttack, AutoClick, Boss Focus with teleport and priority logic

Automation:
Auto Tower and Auto Trial with wave threshold system and auto retry

Event System:
Auto Collect Meteor

Star Roll:
Fast Auto Roll, Hide Reward UI, Disable Reward UI (session-persistent)

Roll Clans, Races, Breathings, and Haki

QoL & Utility:
Anti AFK, Auto Reconnect, Player Teleport, Server Hop/Rejoin, Save and Load Config (auto-load supported)

Notes:

-Boss Focus requires AutoFarm enabled.
-Auto Tower and Auto Trial can run simultaneously (Trial prioritized).
-Disable Reward UI is permanent for the current session (rejoin to restore).
-You can use this script either on pub server or together with ur friends to do Tower/Trial

Now supported Solara/Xeno but features might be limited
